temporal-replay-actor-knowledge-v0.1.jso.interpretation: Retrospective actor-knowledge view: late-captured evt-003 is included because its actor-availability claim is before the cutoff; evt-002 is excluded because it became available after the cutoff.

temporal-replay-ledger-as-of-v0.1.json.interpretation: Ledger-as-recorded view: all events recorded after the ledger cutoff are excluded, even when actor availability is asserted earlier.

temporal-replay-restated-v0.1.json.interpretation: Retrospective restatement: once evt-002 is available to the actor, its 09:30 effective-time invalidation marks evt-001 stale for a 10:00 valid-time query.
